from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityData(BaseModel):
    """One university's metrics from a CDS report, for evaluating space crunch criteria."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the university")
    total_enrollment: int | None = Field(description="Grand Total All Students enrollment figure")
    freshman_housing_percentage: float | None = Field(description="Percentage of first-time first-year students living in college-affiliated housing")
    semester: str | None = Field(description="The data period, e.g. 'Fall 2021'")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Brief verbatim anchor from the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    universities: list[UniversityData]
